# Analysis of `r params$nameofanalysis` data

## Statistical Model

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
dt <- params$nameofanalysis
fn <- params$cov_model

matern_eq <- paste0(
  "$$\\mathcal{M}(u;\\,\\phi,\\kappa) = \\frac{1}{2^{\\kappa-1}\\,\\Gamma(\\kappa)}",
  "\\left(\\frac{u}{\\phi}\\right)^\\kappa K_\\kappa\\!\\left(\\frac{u}{\\phi}\\right)$$"
)
exponential_eq <- "$$C(u;\\,\\phi) = \\exp\\!\\left(-\\frac{u}{\\phi}\\right)$$"
gaussian_eq    <- "$$C(u;\\,\\phi) = \\exp\\!\\left(-\\frac{u^2}{\\phi^2}\\right)$$"
spherical_eq   <- paste0(
  "$$C(u;\\,\\phi) = \\begin{cases}",
  "1 - \\tfrac{3}{2}\\tfrac{u}{\\phi} + \\tfrac{1}{2}\\left(\\tfrac{u}{\\phi}\\right)^3 & u \\le \\phi \\\\\\\\",
  "0 & u > \\phi \\end{cases}$$"
)

cov_eq <- switch(fn,
  matern      = matern_eq,
  exponential = exponential_eq,
  gaussian    = gaussian_eq,
  spherical   = spherical_eq,
  matern_eq
)

nugget_line <- ifelse(isTRUE(params$has_nugget),
  "and $Z_i \\sim N(0,\\,\\tau^2)$ is an independent nugget effect (measurement error).",
  "")

if (dt == "continuous") {
  cat("The linear geostatistical model for continuous data is:

$$Y(\\mathbf{x}_i) = \\boldsymbol{\\beta}^\\top \\mathbf{d}(\\mathbf{x}_i) + S(\\mathbf{x}_i) + Z_i$$

where $\\boldsymbol{\\beta}$ are regression coefficients, $\\mathbf{d}(\\mathbf{x}_i)$ is a covariate vector,
$S(\\mathbf{x})$ is a zero-mean stationary Gaussian process with covariance function

$$\\mathrm{Cov}(S(\\mathbf{x}),\\,S(\\mathbf{x}')) = \\sigma^2\\,C(\\|\\mathbf{x}-\\mathbf{x}'\\|;\\,\\phi)$$
", cov_eq, nugget_line, "\n\n")

} else if (dt == "prevalence") {
  if (!is.null(params$fit_linear) && params$fit_linear == "linearmodel") {
    cat("A linear model on the logit-transformed prevalence was fitted:

$$\\mathrm{logit}(p_i) = \\boldsymbol{\\beta}^\\top \\mathbf{d}(\\mathbf{x}_i) + S(\\mathbf{x}_i) + Z_i$$

where $S(\\mathbf{x})$ is a Gaussian process with covariance

$$\\mathrm{Cov}(S(\\mathbf{x}),\\,S(\\mathbf{x}')) = \\sigma^2\\,C(\\|\\mathbf{x}-\\mathbf{x}'\\|;\\,\\phi)$$
", cov_eq, nugget_line, "\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("The binomial generalised linear geostatistical model for prevalence data is:

$$Y_i \\mid p(\\mathbf{x}_i) \\sim \\mathrm{Binomial}(m_i,\\, p(\\mathbf{x}_i))$$

$$\\mathrm{logit}(p(\\mathbf{x}_i)) = \\boldsymbol{\\beta}^\\top \\mathbf{d}(\\mathbf{x}_i) + S(\\mathbf{x}_i) + Z_i$$

where $S(\\mathbf{x})$ is a zero-mean Gaussian process with covariance

$$\\mathrm{Cov}(S(\\mathbf{x}),\\,S(\\mathbf{x}')) = \\sigma^2\\,C(\\|\\mathbf{x}-\\mathbf{x}'\\|;\\,\\phi)$$
", cov_eq, nugget_line, "\n\n")
  }

} else if (dt == "count") {
  cat("The Poisson generalised linear geostatistical model for count data is:

$$Y_i \\mid \\lambda(\\mathbf{x}_i) \\sim \\mathrm{Poisson}(e_i \\cdot \\lambda(\\mathbf{x}_i))$$

$$\\log(\\lambda(\\mathbf{x}_i)) = \\boldsymbol{\\beta}^\\top \\mathbf{d}(\\mathbf{x}_i) + S(\\mathbf{x}_i) + Z_i$$

where $e_i$ is the exposure offset, $S(\\mathbf{x})$ is a zero-mean Gaussian process with covariance

$$\\mathrm{Cov}(S(\\mathbf{x}),\\,S(\\mathbf{x}')) = \\sigma^2\\,C(\\|\\mathbf{x}-\\mathbf{x}'\\|;\\,\\phi)$$
", cov_eq, nugget_line, "\n\n")
}
cat("In all models, $\\phi$ is the spatial scale (range) parameter and $\\sigma^2$ is the partial sill (spatial variance).\n\n")
```
